window_identity.WT2: all configs scored on runs_partial_ppl/windows.pt (sha e646cf7c...), the same 128 windows in sorted stream order; the heldout run verified WT2 per-window NLL bitwise against history for every parity config
window_identity.C4HO: all configs scored on runs_heldout_bitwidth_validation/heldout_windows.pt (sha e105f974...), fixed order by shard row; same file for MoE and dense (dense tokenizer re-tokenizes identically)
